changes.observable_property: Rebalanced once-per-load static definition projection is all-or-nothing. Before projection-dependent runtime behavior is allowed, all affected definitions are captured and projected successfully; on any failure exact pre-projection state is restored, Rebalanced runtime consumers remain disabled for that load, and Rebalanced-only presentation semantics stop advertising unavailable mechanics.
changes.canonical_owner: RebalancedStaticProjection owns the once-per-load definition transaction. A small Rebalanced runtime readiness state is the canonical admission signal consumed by projection-dependent mechanic hooks and Rebalanced-only presentation providers.
changes.final_writer_or_commit_point: RebalancedStaticProjection.FillCraftsListPostfix is the transaction/activation boundary: successful completion commits projected definitions and marks Rebalanced runtime ready; failure restores the snapshot and marks Rebalanced runtime disabled before later gameplay consumers can apply custom mechanics.
blast_radius: Rebalanced-only semantic/presentation providers after projection failure
preserved_invariants: successful 1.407 projected values and runtime mechanics remain behavior-identical
optional missing DLC prayer definitions remain optional
Roots definition validation remains pre-mutation
no persistent snapshot or save data is introduced

changes.acceptance_evidence: Source review must enumerate every field/list mutated by ApplyOnce and prove it is captured before the first mutation and restored on failure. Every projection-dependent Rebalanced hook/provider must be gated on the same readiness state. CI build must pass. Verified 1.407 runtime smoke must show projection reaches ready and accepted mechanics/presentation remain available; no deliberate destructive fault injection is required in the user's save.
